content.text:
Confirmed: the file-creation commit (40ce9252) didn't contain `getPageNumberFor` at all; it was added later in 678cddcd64cc919c5fe570af48ae50ca99e39405 with the `pageNum = 0` initialization that is the root cause of the off-by-one bug fixed by HEAD.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 678cddcd64cc919c5fe570af48ae50ca99e39405

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation process:** The fix commit changes `int pageNum = 0;` to `int pageNum = -1;` inside `getPageNumberFor(int, int)` in `BookView.java`. I traced the history of this method using `git log -p --follow` on `BookView.java`, which showed that the method (along with its `pageNum = 0` initialization) was moved into `BookView.java` from `PageTurnerSpine.java` in commit `ca07a402e385bd079a6b7d5eddea4531dea06dad` (it previously was called as `spine.getPageNumberFor(...)`). I then followed `PageTurnerSpine.java`'s history (`git log --all -p --follow`) and found the method, with the identical buggy `pageNum = 0` line, was originally authored in commit `678cddcd64cc919c5fe570af48ae50ca99e39405` (Dec 8, 2012), which added `getPageNumberFor`, `getTotalNumberOfPages`, and `setPageOffsets` to `PageTurnerSpine.java` as brand-new code. I verified that the commit which created the file (`40ce9252`) did not yet contain this method, confirming `678cddc` is the true point of introduction, not just a copy of pre-existing logic.

**(2) Specific change that introduced the bug:** In `678cddc`, `pageNum` is initialized to `0` before a loop that accumulates the page count of all spine sections preceding `index`:
```java
int pageNum = 0;
for (int i=0; i < index; i++) { pageNum += pageOffsets.get(i).size(); }
...
for (int i=0; i < offsets.size() && offsets.get(i) < position; i++) { pageNum++; }
return pageNum;
```
Because pages are 0-indexed (the first page in a section should be page 0), starting the accumulator at `0` instead of `-1` causes the returned page number to be off by one too high for every index/position — this is the exact bug that `16abeae7` corrects by changing the seed value to `-1`.

**(3) Supporting evidence:** The logic and even the exact string `int pageNum = 0;` persisted unchanged (modulo later debug logging and null checks) through the method's move from `PageTurnerSpine` to `BookView` in `ca07a402`, and all the way to immediately before the fix commit `16abeae7`. No other commit in the method's history altered this initialization value; `678cddc` is the sole point where it was set, and it has been incorrect since.

I'm highly confident in this identification — the code path is small, well-isolated, and its history is linear with no merges or reverts obscuring the trace.
